premise: In a colossal glass rail interchange, platform boarding passes are granted only to travelers who contract to cultivate and maintain the train life-support gardens during their journey.
simulation_objective: Manage personal boarding priority, negotiate carriage crop tenders, and balance station-wide ecological transit demands to reach distant terminals.
economy_focus: Labor-for-transit bartering driven by crop yield, seed rarity, and life-support requirements.
exploration_focus: Navigating shifting platform layouts, hydroponic nursery carriages, and hidden arboretum vaults.
conflict_tone: Civic tension, resource friction, and ideological disputes over transit labor equity.
visual_style: Art Nouveau ironwork interwoven with lush hydroponic greenery, luminescent mist, and vintage steam gauges.

gameplay_loops.pressure: Unresolved tillage grievances trigger valve lockdowns, cutting oxygen generation en route.

player_entry_points: Arrive at Central Concourse Labor Bureau holding expired hydroponic transit scrip.
Report to Carriage Agronomy Oversight Lab following a canopy blight alert.
Detained at Express Platform Turnstile Gate 1 for carrying unregistered seed pods.
conflict_hooks: The union threatens to seal the Hydroponic Trough Staging Bay valves unless root-vegetable laborers receive high-yield seed allocations.
A sudden drop in canopy crop vitality triggers automated locks at Express Platform Turnstile Gate 1, trapping commuters in the concourse.
Contraband germplasm discovered in the Canopy Seed Reserve Bank points to high-level tampering by express-tier brokers.

open_action_examples.situation: The Broker seeks to bypass turnstiles by issuing an unauthorized canopy maintenance pass in exchange for illicit germplasm.
coordinator_checks: Verify initiator possesses blank registry tokens.
Confirm target holds viable germplasm in inventory.
Ensure both roles are co-located in Central Concourse Labor Bureau.
Enforce that created forged pass lacks official seal state tag.

open_action_examples.situation: The Steward attempts to freeze boarding at Express Platform Turnstile Gate 1 due to oxygen deficit hazards.
coordinator_checks: Check that initiating role holds active union steward authorization.
Verify platform queue density exceeds critical threshold.
Ensure proximity within Express Platform Turnstile Gate 1.
Confirm target warden receives enforceable grievance status.

open_action_examples.situation: The Agronomist demands an immediate transfer of rare germplasm to prevent canopy blight collapse.
coordinator_checks: Confirm initiator has documented blight assay records.
Verify target custodian is within Canopy Seed Reserve Bank.
Validate high-yield seed stock quantity in vault ledger.
Check for absence of active vault lockdown state.

open_action_examples.action_name: Conscript Idle Commuter for High-Trellis Pruning
open_action_examples.situation: The Scribe attempts to reassign a courier into manual foliage pruning to clear concourse congestion.
coordinator_checks: Verify target role has unassigned carriage labor hours.
Ensure both actors are in Central Concourse Labor Bureau.
Confirm initiator holds valid labor registry documentation.
Check that target consents or platform congestion mandates draft.

social_rules: Passengers must maintain active crop maintenance contracts to traverse express turnstiles.
Uncertified germplasm transfers outside the Canopy Seed Reserve Bank constitute botanical contraband.
Union picket cordons at Hydroponic Trough Staging Bay require formal mediation before forceful clearance.
Carriage life-support biomass quotas supersede personal transit departures during oxygen deficit alerts.

item_catalog.name: Brass Pneumatic Moisture Gauge
item_catalog.description: Vintage steam-valve pressure dial with a brass probe, designed to measure hydroponic moisture and nutrient density.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Art Nouveau brass moisture meter with glass dials, intricate filigree steam gauges, and a polished copper root probe resting against green moss.

item_catalog.name: Titanium Vine-Pruning Shears
item_catalog.description: Ergonomic bypass pruning shears with self-oiling joints, essential for high-canopy trellis maintenance shifts.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Sleek curved botanical hand pruners with polished titanium blades and etched floral brass handles, glowing hydroponic nutrient residue.

item_catalog.name: Aerated Tillage Trowel
item_catalog.description: Perforated bronze hand trowel used by Root-Tender migrants to loosen submerged aggregate without slicing delicate roots.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Artistic bronze hand spade with decorative leafy perforations, resting on dark nutrient-rich substrate under soft teal mist.

item_catalog.name: High-Yield Sky-Spire Vine Germplasm
item_catalog.description: Hermetically sealed glass ampoule holding engineered fast-growing vines capable of rapid canopy oxygen generation.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Glass ampoule filled with glowing emerald seeds, secured inside an embossed brass protective casing with solarpunk filigree.

item_catalog.name: Carriage Tuber Spore Pack
item_catalog.description: Dense fungal and tuber spore mixture yielding steady biomass in dark sleeper carriage sub-floor troughs.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Woven burlap packet sealed with green wax, dusted with golden mycorrhizal spores on polished iron train flooring.

item_catalog.name: Luminescent Mist-Kelp Inoculant
item_catalog.description: High-transpiration kelp spores that scrub atmospheric carbon and generate luminescent vapor in carriage ducts.
item_catalog.image_prompt: Bioluminescent cyan spores suspended inside a delicate crystal phial with brass steam-release caps.

item_catalog.name: Gilded Express Commuter Token
item_catalog.description: Color-coded brass and enameled token authorizing priority turnstile access for verified canopy contract holders.

item_catalog.name: Algal Oxygenation Screen

item_catalog.image_prompt: Vintage embossed tin box open to reveal neat emerald-green hexagonal wafers, surrounded by solarpunk concourse mist.

default_rule.palette_notes: Balanced blend of spruce green (#224b3c), warm canvas beige (#b58750), and glowing mint trim (#7ae582).
default_rule.silhouette_notes: Standard 2-head top-down proportion with identifiable glowing chest badge and modest belt pouches.

visual_consistency_rules: Maintain strict 90-degree orthographic top-down view: head, broad shoulders, and back-mounted gear dominate the 64x64 frame.
Outline all character sprites with a crisp 1px solid dark bronze rim (#121d18) for clear contrast against floor tiles.
Ensure every character carries at least one glowing luminescent element (#7ae582 or #e9f7eb) representing life-support tokens, seed tubes, or gauge dials.
Keep silhouettes distinctly legible via specific back equipment: tanks for mechanics, canisters for agronomists, baskets for foragers, clean profiles for arbiters.
Limit color depth to the canonical solarpunk palette: deep spruce, warm brass, sage mist, and rich soil tones.
